scores.visual_critic_note: Deliberate colorblind-safe palette and combined swarm+boxplot+percentile-line layers show real design intent, but the P25/P50/P75 callout labels visibly collide near $32K–$56K and the top-earner leader lines tangle on the right, with the outermost label clipped at the viewport edge.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Log scale is appropriate and correctly applied, box plot uses proper Tukey IQR math with data-driven percentile lines, no lie factor or baseline violations, but the x-domain is hardcoded [14000,550000] rather than derived from data via d3.extent, and the swarm join lacks key functions for update robustness.
scores.stress_test_note: Fully static pre-computed swarm with no brush/zoom/transitions or cross-view dispatch; pointer-unified tooltip events sidestep the mouse-touch fight, leaving no actionable interaction robustness violations.
scores.cognitive_load_note: 4-category colorblind-safe palette, single conceptual view, and well-separated 400-dot swarm read cleanly; minor callout crowding where 5 leader lines converge at the right tail slightly increases lookup effort.

proposer: Good. 228 lines (236 → 228 = -8 lines). Consolidated the whisker line + caps into a single path element and inlined the forEach clamp.
